'''Ingah Muloha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a commanding officer of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] garrison on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Troopers under her command discovered a [[Bafforr tree]] grove created by [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] in the desert and informed Muloha. She contacted a local Imperial sympathizer, [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Centa Sonhan]], and had her subordinates pin false charges on Nadon and had him apprehended. She was killed aboard [[Centa Sonhan's sail barge|Centa Sohan's sail barge]], when it was attacked by agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] trying to free Nadon.
